_說明: 每一項的 name 就是遊戲裡的音效名稱（assets/audio/<name>）。生成後經 finish.py 轉成 <name>.ogg 放進 assets/audio/，遊戲會自動用它取代原本的合成音。prompt 用英文效果最好；voice 的台詞用繁體中文。

music.name: music_camp
music.prompt: Quiet night at a campfire beside a misty lake. Solo fingerpicked nylon guitar and a soft medieval lute, warm low cello sustains, faint music-box twinkles, gentle and cozy but a little lonely, fantasy RPG rest-area theme, sparse, unhurried, no drums, instrumental, seamless loop

music.name: music_night
music.prompt: Night fishing on a dark haunted lake. Low eerie drones, slow plucked kalimba motif, distant breathy choir, soft muffled taiko like a heartbeat, creeping tension without jump scares, dark fantasy horror ambience, minimal, instrumental, seamless loop

music.name: music_day
music.prompt: Bright peaceful lakeside morning. Light acoustic guitar strumming, wooden flute melody, soft hand percussion and shaker, birds-in-the-air feeling, relaxed fishing adventure, cozy indie game soundtrack, instrumental, seamless loop

ambience.name: amb_camp

ambience.name: amb_night

ambience.name: amb_water
ambience.prompt: Close lakeshore: small waves lapping against stones and a wooden dock, soft gurgling, light breeze, night, no music

ambience.name: amb_wind
ambience.prompt: Cold night wind moving through tall pine trees, branches creaking softly, gusts rising and falling, lonely open landscape, no music

ambience.name: amb_rain
ambience.prompt: Steady rain falling on a lake and on leaves, drops on wood and water, soft and continuous, distant rumble, no music

ambience.name: amb_surf
ambience.prompt: Ocean surf at night on a rocky beach, waves rolling in and washing back over pebbles, wind, no music

ambience.name: amb_swamp
ambience.prompt: Night swamp: many frogs croaking in chorus, insects buzzing, bubbling mud, dripping water, humid and dense, no music

ambience.name: amb_jungle
ambience.prompt: Tropical jungle at night: dense insects, strange bird calls, tree frogs, dripping leaves, distant river, no music

ambience.name: amb_day
ambience.prompt: Sunny morning by a forest lake: songbirds chirping, light breeze in leaves, gentle water, peaceful, no music

merchant.design: 一位年長的青蛙旅行商人，男聲，嗓音低沉、略帶沙啞和一點鼻音，說話慢條斯理，帶著狡黠和幽默，句尾偶爾拖長，像在打量客人的錢包。
merchant.ref_text: 歡迎、歡迎……這麼晚還出來的客人，可不多呀。

lines.name: voice_merchant_hello_1
lines.text: 歡迎、歡迎……這麼晚還出來的客人，可不多呀。

lines.name: voice_merchant_hello_2
lines.text: 喔？又是你啊。今晚想帶點什麼？

lines.name: voice_merchant_browse
lines.text: 慢慢看，這些可都是好東西，呱。

lines.name: voice_merchant_sell
lines.text: 這條魚……嗯，算你識貨，我收了。

lines.name: voice_merchant_poor
lines.text: 錢不夠啊？那下次再來吧，呱。

lines.name: voice_merchant_bye
lines.text: 路上小心。湖裡的東西……可不只有魚。

lines.name: voice_merchant_idle_2
lines.text: 燈油要帶夠，黑暗會吃人的。

willow.design: 古老柳樹的精靈，女聲，空靈、輕柔，帶著氣聲，語速很慢，語氣溫和卻神秘，像在夜風裡低語。
willow.ref_text: 孩子……你又回到這片湖了。

lines.name: voice_willow_hello
lines.text: 孩子……你又回到這片湖了。

lines.name: voice_willow_offer
lines.text: 把湖的饋贈還給湖吧，它會記得你的。

lines.name: voice_willow_full
lines.text: 夠了……石柱已經醒來，快走吧。

lines.name: voice_willow_evil
lines.text: 這份祭品……帶著不好的東西。
